task: One pairwise judging round of a tournament. The lead advances winners into the next round with a fresh requestId.

nodes.task: Compare the two candidates in context.candidates['pair-1'] against the judging criterion. Return JSON: { winner: <id>, loser: <id>, reason: <one sentence>, confidence: 0-1 }. If the criterion cannot separate them, say so explicitly.
Compare the two candidates in context.candidates['pair-2'] against the judging criterion. Return JSON: { winner: <id>, loser: <id>, reason: <one sentence>, confidence: 0-1 }.
Collect both judge results from context.graph.upstream into a winners list and a losers list with reasons. The lead uses this to build the next round.
